topic.readerProblem: Decide whether AERank free, single-business, or agency monitoring fits the required evidence workflow.
topic.connection: Helps AEOeye readers compare recurring local AI visibility monitoring after a baseline scan.

assessment: The final AERank Pricing (2026): Free Scan, Pro, Agency, and Client Cost guide answers a direct AEO-software buying question with official documentation, reproducible arithmetic, explicit documentation-only limits, and a concrete fit decision. It does not claim product use or outcome testing.

sources.supports: Official free scan, Pro and Agency prices, engines, cadence, client limit, reports, and support.

checks: The main editor opened every named source and reconciled the visible amount, currency or unavailable-price status, billing cadence, allowance, and access boundary with the final article.
The main editor independently recomputed every worked example from cited inputs and kept checkout, quote, tax, or unknown-field caveats adjacent to the arithmetic.
The main editor read the complete final draft, including opening, tables, images and alt text, internal links, limitations, conclusion, and all four FAQs.

The main editor confirmed the article is explicitly documentation-based and contains no claim of paid-account use, output-quality testing, ranking result, guaranteed outcome, or internal production note.
